_doc_1691: #1691 row 0 is exactly Update · Uninstall · Fetch · Clear · APK, then the kept Install (Rule 16: every earlier action stays, after the five). `download` keeps its id and behaviour (get the apk file into the public Downloads) and is captioned APK. Uninstall is its own button now, dimmed with its reason when the package is absent; Install (prompted store-queue install) is dimmed with its reason when present; Clear is dimmed when nothing is cached and reports the space it freed. A dimmed button still answers a tap with its reason. `install_toggle` stays wired in the code (undrawn), like `direct_install` and `routes`.
_doc: Store ▸ Cloud: the buttons a fleet row's detail offers, IN ORDER, on TWO lines, with their captions and colours. The Kotlin only maps an id to what it does (StoreCloudFragment.rowAction / ApkDetailSheet.detailAction); order, wording and grouping are this file. #1588 redefined the two lines. `rows[0]` is the fetch/install lifecycle line (Update · Uninstall⇄Install · Fetch · Clear · Download), `rows[1]` the open/inspect line (Open · Stop │ Access · Perm │ Libs · About). Verb meanings: Update = fetch the apk AND install it, reusing the cache when present (the prompted BootstrapInstall system-sheet path). `install_toggle` is ONE button that shows `label` (Install) when the package is absent and `label_installed` (Uninstall) when it is present, and runs the matching action (prompted system-sheet install when absent, Uninstall when present). Fetch = cache the apk only, no install (StoreStages' cache-only download). Clear = delete the cached apk (StoreStages' clear). Download = copy/stream the apk into the phone's public Downloads (/storage/emulated/0/Download, via MediaStore) for the user to keep. `divider_before` draws the owner's `│` rule before a button, grouping Open/Stop apart from the Access/Perm pair and that apart from the Libs/About pair. The inspect ids open sub-sheets over the page (nav bar and back stay — they never replace the bottom nav): Access (the per-app access surface — MCP · API · IPC · ID · Perms tabs, StoreInspect.Access over StoreAccess), Perm (the per-app perms sheet — Manifest / Auto grants / Runtime tables), Libs (compiled-in + bound engines), About (the full detail sheet, ApkDetailSheet). Stop goes through the fleet's EXISTING privileged door — ShellChannels — and says so with no channel armed. The `routes` and `direct_install` handlers stay wired in the code but are no longer drawn on the row per #1588. test-store-fleet-actions.sh holds the two-line shape, the toggle, the dividers, and that every id has a handler; test-store-inspect.sh holds the inspect sheets and their data sources.
_doc_fields: id = the verb the code dispatches on; label = the caption drawn; color = the button fill (ARGB hex). `label_installed`/`color_installed` = the toggle's caption/fill while the package is installed. `divider_before` = draw a `│` rule before this button. The `details` entries feed the About sheet's Actions card (ApkDetailSheet.detailAction); each carries `detail`, the right-hand hint on the sheet's action line.
